description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the data foundation for pricing in an early-stage internet marketplace. You will turn noisy sold-listing data into reliable comparable items and price estimates, helping users and investors understand both the value and confidence of each estimate.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own scheduled ingestion pipelines for sold-listing data from multiple marketplaces and external sources.

 - Design entity resolution systems that match inconsistent listing text and images to canonical items.

 - Develop valuation logic that weights comparable listings by recency, condition, and quantity.

 - Create production monitoring to detect data drift, fraud, stale comparisons, and integrity issues.

 - Partner with computer vision teammates to define how items are matched across sources with varying detail.

 - Make build-versus-buy decisions about data sources, licensing, and third-party pricing feeds.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of data engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale production ETL and data pipelines.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, Airflow or Dagster, and Spark or similar tools.

 - Experience working with noisy or adversarial data in marketplaces, pricing, fraud, or a related domain.

 - Experience with statistical estimation or pricing models, including regression-based comparable sales logic.

 - Experience building entity resolution or record-matching systems at scale, plus production data quality monitoring.

 - Ability to make sound data quality tradeoffs and explain pricing confidence and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Experience processing data from multiple external sources and evaluating data products or integrations is valuable.

 - Pricing intelligence, data licensing, and early-stage startup experience are helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Hybrid, New York, New York, United States.
